message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The case involves a public official (常2某) who abused position to accept bribes (cash and jewelry) in exchange for helping obtain state innovation fund projects. That's bribery (受贿). Also he participated in falsifying project applications and facilitating illegal withdrawal of funds, i.e., abuse of power (滥用职权) and possibly embezzlement? He helped collude to obtain public funds illegally, which is "职务侵占" or "贪污"? He is a public official, using position to facilitate illegal procurement of funds, which is "受贿" for taking bribes, and "滥用职权" for abusing authority to approve false projects and facilitate illegal fund withdrawal. Also possibly "挪用资金" but the description: they set up false projects and then the funds were taken by the other official (聂某甲). The official facilitated that, which is "滥用职权" (abuse of power) and maybe "贪污" (embezzlement) if he appropriated funds. The text says 150万补助被套取, 104万被聂某甲占为己有. The official didn't keep the money, but facilitated. So likely charge: 受贿;滥用职权. In examples, similar case (姜1某) had 受贿;滥用职权. So we follow that.

Thus final answer: [罪名]受贿;滥用职权<eoa>
